notes: SpaceWire characterization centers on the LVDS Data/Strobe eye and levels, Data-Strobe skew tolerance, the data signalling rate, the ErrorReset..Run initialization timing, the ~850 ns disconnect timeout, credit-based flow control, and Time-Code latency / jitter. Per-link SerDes and connector/cable calibration is done at bring-up; conformance is established by SpaceWire (ECSS) testing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: LVDS eye / levels
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the ~350 mV differential output around ~1.2 V common-mode on the Data/Strobe pairs.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Data-Strobe skew tolerance
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the link tolerates up to ~one bit period of D/S skew; clock = Data XOR Strobe.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Data signalling rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate operation from 2 Mbps to 200+ Mbps; 10 Mbit/s default at reset.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Link initialization timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure the ErrorReset (~6.4 us) and ErrorWait/timeout (~12.8 us) intervals and NULL/FCT exchange.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Disconnect timeout
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm disconnect detection at ~850 ns of inactivity.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Flow-control credit
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify one FCT grants eight N-Chars and at most 56 are outstanding.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Time-Code latency / jitter
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure system-time distribution latency and jitter across the network.
